# Lisbon 4-Day Trip Plan: Apr 10–13, 2026

A balanced Lisbon plan for 2 adults with **museums, walking, and local food**, keeping the trip **under €1,200 excluding flights**. I’ve assumed **1 centrally located hotel room under €150/night** and a mix of **paid + free activities**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Riverfront First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Check in, then walk **Rossio → Praça do Comércio → Rua Augusta Arch area** for an easy intro to central Lisbon.
- Afternoon: Visit **MUDE (Design Museum)** if open, or swap for a self-guided stroll through **Chiado** and **Carmo Convent exterior**.
- Dinner: Try a classic tascas meal near **Baixa/Chiado**: grilled fish, bifana, or daily prato do dia.

### Day 2: Alfama, Fado, and Historic Lisbon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Walk **Alfama** early before crowds; include **Lisbon Cathedral** and viewpoints like **Miradouro de Santa Luzia**.
- Afternoon: Choose one museum stop: **National Tile Museum** or **Fado Museum**, then wander the narrow streets at your own pace.
- Dinner: Book a **small Fado house** or keep it budget-friendly with petiscos in Alfama.

### Day 3: Belém Culture Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Go to **Belém** for the **Jerónimos Monastery exterior**, **Belém Tower area**, and riverside walking.
- Afternoon: Pick one paid stop: **Coach Museum** or **MAAT**; add a free riverside walk if you want to save.
- Dinner: Return central for a relaxed dinner and, if you want, a **pastel de nata stop** before heading back.

### Day 4: Free Views, Neighborhood Wandering, and Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Ride a tram or walk up to **Graça / Senhora do Monte** for views, then browse local streets and small shops.
- Afternoon: Use the final hours for a light museum or a free neighborhood loop through **Mouraria** and **Intendente**.
- Dinner: If your flight is later, finish with a simple seafood or petiscos meal near the hotel.

## Budget Breakdown and Recommended Spend

| Category | Estimated Cost | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel, 3 nights | **€390–€450** | Central 3-star or small boutique, aim under €150/night |
| Food & drinks | **€300–€360** | Mix of breakfast cafés, lunch menus, and casual dinners |
| Local transport | **€25–€45** | Metro, tram, occasional taxi/Uber |
| Museums & paid sights | **€90–€160** | 3–5 paid entries total, depending on choices |
| Coffee, pastries, extras | **€40–€70** | Pastéis, snacks, water, small treats |
| Buffer | **€80–€120** | For taxi, extra meal, or one splurge |
| **Total** | **€925–€1,205** | Keeps you close to the target budget |

## Money-Saving Picks in Lisbon

- Stay in **Baixa, Chiado, or Avenida da Liberdade edge** so you can walk to many sights and cut transport costs.
- Use **one paid museum per day at most**; Lisbon has lots of strong free walking areas and viewpoints.
- Choose **lunch menus / prato do dia** for the best value meal of the day.
- Skip taxis inside the center when possible; Lisbon is very walkable, though hilly.
- Replace one museum with a **free neighborhood day** in Alfama, Graça, or Belém.
- Buy pastries and coffee from local cafés instead of hotel breakfasts if breakfast is not included.

## Centrally Located Hotel Ideas Under €150/Night

### Best-fit hotel zone: Baixa / Chiado / Avenida
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best for walking access to museums, restaurants, and transit.
- Good value often appears in smaller 3-star properties and aparthotels.
- Expect the best prices if you book early and keep room preferences flexible.

### What to look for
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Air conditioning**
- **Elevator**
- **Breakfast optional**
- **Metro access within 5–10 minutes**
- **Guest rating 8.0+**

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Search hotels] https://www.booking.com/city/pt/lisbon.html
Action: [Button: Lisbon museums] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/museums
Action: [Button: Metro info] https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/

## Sources

- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en
- Lisbon Metro: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
- MUDE museum: https://mude.pt/en/
- National Tile Museum: https://museudoazulejo.gov.pt/english/
